scope: read-only database size and retention diagnostics

cron_history.growth_note: Six full days each had about 102000 runs. Estimated disk growth about 30 MB/day if the current bytes/row stays similar.

festapp_merge.id_mappings.note: Runtime image project logic still references mappings; not a blind deletion candidate.

toast_space.interpretation: Allocated heap versus visible payload indicates substantial reusable/dead space, especially information; includes tuple/page overhead. Not an exact pgstattuple bloat measurement.

health.statistics_warning: n_live_tup is not the actual total for imported tables; exact aggregate counts used for selected tables. pgstattuple is not installed and was not enabled.

recommended_order: Bound successful pg_cron history retention without disabling the one-second application job.
Define separate retention policies for configuration telemetry and authentication security audit.
Plan non-destructive relation maintenance to reclaim allocated space, with production lock/WAL/disk safeguards.
Review historical database recovery/dependency requirements before any retirement.
